title: Membership in the School of Mathematics (2027-28)
institution: Institute for Advanced Study (IAS), School of Mathematics
about: Memberships at the IAS School of Mathematics for the 2027-28 academic year, which features a special year on Expansion and Computation (September 2027-April 2028). Applications and recommendation letters go through MathJobs by December 1.
requirements: Letters of recommendation due by the same December 1 deadline
